name: The majority voted against a motion introduced by Labor MP [Amanda Rishworth](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/kingston/amanda_rishworth) (Kingston), which means it failed. This motion would have amended the usual [second reading motion](https://www.peo.gov.au/learning/fact-sheets/making-a-law.html) "that the bill be read a second time" (which was parliamentary jargon "that the main idea of the bill be agreed to") with the words below. ### Motion text > *That all words after "That" be omitted with a view to substituting the following words:* > *"whilst not declining to give the bill a second reading, the House notes with concern that the Government has undermined veterans' access to health services".*
